seo.description: Rifat Sarwar: backend engineer who gets his hands dirty with ML and embedded systems. Microservices on AWS, LLMs squeezed onto small hardware, a Mars rover ranked 6th globally, and drones built from scratch.

footer.tagline: Backend Engineer · ML & Embedded Systems. Built in Bangladesh with curiosity and occasional panic.
footer.disclaimer: The AI twin is an AI, not actually Rifat, and it can be wrong. Chat messages go to Google's Gemini API to generate replies. This site doesn't store them, but Google may use them to improve its products, so don't share anything private.
